title: Machi Koro-style round category icon spec
purpose: Reusable specification for the small circular category badge placed immediately before a Machi Koro-style card title.

reference_observation.badge: The original Russian Machi Koro cards use a solid colored circular badge.
reference_observation.symbol: Inside the circle is a simple white pictogram.
reference_observation.contrast: The icon is essentially two-color: colored circle + white symbol.
reference_observation.style: Flat, compact, highly legible, with no realistic rendering, texture, or 3D effects.
reference_observation.placement_context: The badge is visually glued to the title row and should later be centered together with the title as one horizontal group.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the icon asset; it will be composited before the title by the card-rendering script.
integration_context.background: Native RGBA transparency is mandatory outside the circular badge. Do not draw or bake a checkerboard, transparency-preview grid, black or white field, solid backdrop, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, shadow, or any other background representation into RGB.
integration_context.output_preference: RGBA PNG with alpha=0 outside the circular badge and clean antialiased alpha edges
integration_context.composition: one centered circular badge filling most of the square canvas

icon_color.description: Fill color of the circular badge. For the current blue card family, use the same dark blue as the footer.

subject.description: The white pictogram drawn inside the colored circle.

badge_geometry.border: no separate outline unless needed only for antialiasing; visually it should read as a flat solid circle

pictogram.subject: {{ICON_SUBJECT}}
pictogram.shape_language: very simple, chunky, geometric, slightly rounded, icon-like
pictogram.line_rule: Prefer a solid white silhouette or a few thick white shapes; avoid thin line art.

visual_style.core: Flat two-color Machi Koro category badge.
visual_style.colors: one configurable badge color plus pure white pictogram
visual_style.small_size_priority: must remain instantly recognizable when rendered very small beside a card title

anti_patterns: do not generate only a colored pictogram without the round badge
do not make the pictogram the same color as the badge
do not add a white outer ring around the badge
do not use realistic house rendering
do not use gradients, highlights, bevels, texture, or shadows
do not add card furniture or background scenery
do not output an opaque background or draw a checkerboard or transparency-preview grid; native RGBA alpha transparency is required
do not add a black or white field, solid backdrop, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, or shadow outside the badge
do not make the symbol too detailed or thin
final_prompt_summary: Generate only a small Machi Koro-style category badge on a square canvas. Create one perfect solid circle in the supplied hex color, filling roughly 85% of the canvas. Inside it, center a very simple bold white pictogram of the subject defined in the parameters and pictogram sections. OUTPUT REQUIREMENT: native RGBA transparency is mandatory; every pixel outside the circular badge must have alpha=0. Do not render, draw, or bake a checkerboard, transparency-preview grid, black or white field, solid backdrop, gradient, glow, halo, vignette, shadow, or any other background representation into RGB. The result must be flat two-color vector-style artwork: colored circle plus white symbol, no border, no text, no shading, no gradient, no texture, no 3D effects, and no background.
